description: Na₂LaC₅H₂O₁₁ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.67 Å. La is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.57-2.73 Å. There are five inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.28 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. Both C-O bond lengths are 1.27 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. Both C-O bond lengths are 1.27 Å. In the fourth C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.27 Å) C-O bond length. In the fifth C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. Both C-O bond lengths are 1.27 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one La and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one La and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na, one La, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one La and one C atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one C atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one C atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one C atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one C atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms.
